description: Publish this agent's private Solana account in the Privacy Rings registry, so other Gloam accounts can pay it privately. Gloam's relay pays the record's rent (about 0.0016 SOL); nothing is spent from the agent. Does nothing when it is already registered. Needs GLOAM_AGENT_SOLANA_KEY.

timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for Solana, in ms (default 120000). A send still unsettled then comes back pending with its signature and blockhash.

name: gloam_solana_register
title: Register the Solana private account
